senses.gloss:
Baudhāyana, ‘descendant of Budha or bodha,’ is the name of a teacher who is mentioned in the baudhāyana śrauta sūtra, and under whose name are current a śrauta sūtra described and in part edited by Caland, and a dharma sūtra which has been edited and translated, while the gṛhya sūtra is still unedited.
Foot notes iv. 11, etc.
Über das rituelle sūtra des baudhāyana, 1903.
Bibliotheca Indica, 1904, etc.
By Hultzsch, Leipzig, 1884.
Bühler, Sacred Books of the East, 14. See his Introduction, xxix et seq., where, however, he tends to overestimate considerably the age of baudhāyana.

Baudhī-putra, ‘son of a female descendant of bodha,’ is the name of a pupil of śālaṅkāyanīputra in the last vaṃśa (list of teachers) of the Mādhyaṃdina recension of the Bṛhadāranyaka upaniṣad (vi. 4, 31).
